title: Incomplete Server Removal in Claude MCP Configuration
body:
**Bug Description**
I used "claude mcp remove --scope user _" and it worked in the sense that "claude mcp list" wasnt listing _ anymore. But the server was still defined in "~/.claude/settings.json" which was confusing.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: zed
- Version: 1.0.21
- Feedback ID: a2494388-b775-4566-a636-355f4f67446c
author: zakony-ai
